name: application-07
title: Agent operations
description: A Sundermere operations page on one run: a header that condenses into a slim bar as the page scrolls, a live graph where an edge draws itself and a dot travels out and back for each call, a monitor with the command that waits for Allow or Deny, a budget bar that passes its 80% mark, a fleet that makes every panel follow the agent you pick, a trace waterfall and a board whose cards travel between lanes, in three columns that fold to one by container width. Plug your backend into onApprove and onDeny.
